sleep-logout-reboot.limitation: Same-boot process restart and the virtual clock only. The WSL row is a `wsl --terminate` of the disposable distribution (a boot-ID change inside it is [U], recorded). The devbox is not rebooted (owner's machine). The WSL "wsl --terminate as a restart" row of m03-plan §4.2 was not built in wave 6: the process-restart property runs natively on the devbox, macOS and Windows (reissue_after_runtime_process_restart_same_boot, e2e_exit_m03 real_issuer_activation_reissue_revocation_with_fresh_logins); the boot-ID change inside a terminated distribution stays an unrecorded [U] observation.

P1.title: ADR-0005 §9.3 P1: macOS screen lock: the screen-lock signal observed across a real lock, the signer and issuer serving fresh logins and a new grant from memory while locked, lock-revokes ending its grant (debug build, test store: mechanism evidence only)
P1.limitation: Mechanism evidence only: a debug build on the test store never yields the macOS lock_continuity claim, which waits for a release-profile run on the login keychain of a disposable account (B3; F03). Supersedes tests/evidence/g04-macos-screen-lock-probe.json.

PW1.title: ADR-0005 §9.3 P-W1: Windows desktop lock: the WTS lock signal observed across a real lock, fresh logins and a new grant while locked, DPAPI unprotect at a forced issuer restart under lock, lock-revokes ending its grant (release profile, product DPAPI store)
PW1.limitation: Only a release-profile run on the product DPAPI store is claim-eligible (F03). Supersedes tests/evidence/g04-windows-desktop-lock-probe.json.

steps.a01_setup_apply_writes_the_users_real_ss: setup apply (typed yes on a pty) changes the disposable user's real ~/.ssh/config
steps.a01_ordinary_ssh_alias_without_f: ssh <alias> true, no -F, no isolation options, SSH_AUTH_SOCK at an empty decoy agent
steps.a01_ordinary_git_without_f: git ls-remote and git clone <alias>:<scratch repo> with no GIT_SSH_COMMAND
steps.a01_ordinary_scp_without_f: scp to and from <alias>, bytes compared
steps.a01_unaffected_alias_effective_config_un: ssh -G of an alias the projection does not manage is identical before and after apply
steps.a01_provider_agent_accepted_key_is_the_a: the fixture sshd log accepts only the adopted key's fingerprint
steps.a22_rename_exchange_supported_on_the_hom: renameat2(RENAME_EXCHANGE) works on the disposable home's file system (ext4 exchange support)
steps.t06_uninstall_restores_user_bytes: uninstall: ~/.ssh/config is byte-identical to the original
steps.t06_uninstall_restores_effective_config: uninstall: ssh -G <alias> no longer shows the managed values
steps.a22_birth_time_recorded_on_the_home_fs: statx(STATX_BTIME) on a file in the disposable home: the birth time is filled on its file system (ext4); fact birth-time names the result (m02-plan U4 file_identity_birth_recorded_on_target_fs, WSL ext4; ADR-0007 F25)

steps.m03_wsl_product_store_unavailable_no_pla: without a test store, issuer init on a pty ends issuer_store_unavailable (exit 4): no backup file and no private-key material anywhere in the Heimdall home (headless Linux, unreachable session bus)
steps.m03_wsl_enroll_account_form_verified: enroll <alias> (typed yes) of the account form ends verified; the registry holds exactly one cert-authority,principals="hm:<dest>:<account>" line of this run's CA (fingerprint checked) with its heimdall:enr_ marker, and the existing-access line is untouched
steps.m03_wsl_account_form_registry_is_the_def: enrolled with no --registry-path (resolved_by remote_home), and the root sshd (StrictModes yes, AuthorizedKeysFile .ssh/authorized_keys) logged the verification certificate accepted "found at" the user's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
steps.m03_wsl_enroll_system_form_verified: enroll --form system (typed yes) shows the lines; the CA line and the principal are installed in the system sshd's TrustedUserCAKeys and AuthorizedPrincipalsFile; enroll verify ends verified, and the system sshd logged a certificate accepted via TrustedUserCAKeys
steps.m03_wsl_setup_apply_projects_the_managed: destination prefer <alias> managed for both pairs, then setup apply (typed yes): the user's real ~/.ssh/config includes Heimdall's projection (written at the first apply) and ssh -G of each managed alias names Heimdall's own certificate (the managed definitions are in the included file)
steps.m03_wsl_access_ensure_signed_by_the_real: access ensure per pair (an owner decision approved with a typed yes when asked) yields a grant while the runtime's internal issuer child runs
steps.m03_wsl_ordinary_ssh_managed_alias_witho: ssh <account-form alias> true: alias managed, no -F, no isolation option, SSH_AUTH_SOCK at an empty decoy agent (while a heimdall run holds the pairs' slots: ordinary ssh of a managed alias works only while a binding holds the slot, ADR-0008 D10 item 2; activation on first use is M05)
steps.m03_wsl_ordinary_git_managed_alias_witho: git ls-remote and git clone <account-form alias>:<scratch repo>, no GIT_SSH_COMMAND (while a heimdall run holds the pairs' slots: ordinary ssh of a managed alias works only while a binding holds the slot, ADR-0008 D10 item 2; activation on first use is M05)
steps.m03_wsl_ordinary_scp_managed_alias_witho: scp to and from <account-form alias>, bytes compared (while a heimdall run holds the pairs' slots: ordinary ssh of a managed alias works only while a binding holds the slot, ADR-0008 D10 item 2; activation on first use is M05)
steps.m03_wsl_ordinary_sftp_managed_alias_with: sftp -b put/get through <account-form alias>, bytes compared (while a heimdall run holds the pairs' slots: ordinary ssh of a managed alias works only while a binding holds the slot, ADR-0008 D10 item 2; activation on first use is M05)
steps.m03_wsl_system_form_ordinary_ssh_by_trus: ssh <system-form alias> true: alias managed, no -F (while a heimdall run holds the pairs' slots: ordinary ssh of a managed alias works only while a binding holds the slot, ADR-0008 D10 item 2; activation on first use is M05)
steps.m03_wsl_logins_attributed_to_the_grant_c: every login both root sshds accepted during those clients (at least 6 on the account form, 1 on the system form) is an ED25519-CERT whose key ID heimdall:<env>:<grant>:<n> names the pair's grant, under this run's CA; none by the existing-access key
steps.m03_wsl_strictmodes_refuses_a_group_writ: with ~/.ssh/authorized_keys made group-writable, the same managed login is refused (exit 255) and the root sshd logs bad ownership or modes; the mode is restored
steps.m03_wsl_revoke_on_lock_refused_lock_sign: access lock-behavior --policy <policy> revoke-on-lock is refused: lock_signal_unavailable (no lock signal in the distribution)
steps.m03_wsl_revoke_then_fresh_login_refused: access revoke of each grant; fresh ordinary logins to both aliases fail and neither sshd accepts any login afterwards
steps.m03_wsl_uninstall_lists_the_remote_enrol: uninstall (typed yes) names every enrollment enroll status listed (at least 2); nothing remote is removed
steps.m03_wsl_uninstall_restores_the_users_con: the user's ~/.ssh/config is byte-identical to its bytes before the first setup apply
